scope: train-only F5 held-family smoke; no validation or test access; CPU only; no runtime/default/submission mutation

proposal.source: frozen P18 seed-track endpoint proposal geometry

features.inputs: raw M20 scores, frozen C00 scores, relative x/y/t neighborhoods, complete-video event count

nested_selection.inner_scheme: F1-F4 leave-one-family-out predictions from models trained on two of the other three families
nested_selection.outer_prediction: ensemble of all six F1-F4 pair-fit models; every member is unseen on F5
nested_selection.threshold: selected only from inner held-family OOF scores; no numeric action threshold is frozen
nested_selection.winner: highest conservative pooled inner OOF Challenge score among candidates passing every-fold gates; deterministic tie breaks

inner_gates.false_component_accounting_during_select: sum of nonnegative exact one-action deltas (conservative upper bound)

outer_success_gate.false_components_per_new_correct_object_: inner-OOF winner tradeoff; no F5-derived cutoff
outer_success_gate.if_failed: stop and do not expand to all five outer folds
